How each layout is checked
validator (engine): gap, margin, angle, count
min_gap: sampled point-to-segment distance every 2 mm, independent code (not geom.poly_distance)
no_overlap: vertex-in-solid containment (even-odd, holes respected)
inside_sheet: flattened loops within edge+clamp margin
area: placed solid area equals part true area
angles: multiples of rot_step, locked parts at 0
dxf_roundtrip: written DXF parsed back by the importer, every loop found at the same centre (1 mm) and area (0.5%)
count: every part placed exactly once
bbox baseline: same parts as bounding-box rectangles in the Phase 1 engine
